name: Philipp Matthias Bregy
bio: Philipp Matthias Bregy (born 7 July 1978 in Visp, canton Valais) is a Swiss lawyer and politician of Die Mitte (The Centre). He has been a member of the National Council (Nationalrat) for the canton of Valais since March 2019, when he succeeded Viola Amherd following her election to the Federal Council. From 2021 he chaired The Centre's parliamentary group (Fraktionspräsident) in the Federal Assembly, and on 28 June 2025 the party's delegates elected him national president of Die Mitte, succeeding Gerhard Pfister. A lawyer and notary by profession, he is a partner at the firm Rieder.Pfammatter.Bregy in the Upper Valais. Before his federal career he served in the cantonal parliament of Valais (Grossrat) from 2009 to 2018 and on the municipal council of Naters from 2013 to 2019. He is married and has two children and resides in Naters. He holds the rank of Major in the Swiss Army.
